company.title: Company Overview

overview.title: Company Overview & Security Profile

industry.title: Industry & Business Model
industry.description: Industry structure, competitive position, revenue drivers, pricing power and operating leverage.

business.title: Business Model & Revenue Drivers

growth.title: Growth, Forecasting & Sustainable Growth

valuation.title: Valuation Models
valuation.description: Gordon Growth Model, dividend discount framing, valuation multiples, model-implied value and sensitivity analysis.

relative.title: Relative Valuation & Multiples
relative.description: Company multiples compared with demo peer medians and premium or discount classifications.

peers.title: Benchmark & Peer Comparison

corporateActions.title: Corporate Actions & Shareholder Returns

governance.title: Governance, ESG & Risk Factors
governance.description: Governance and ESG placeholders plus company, industry, financial, valuation, liquidity and regulatory risks.

diagnostics.title: Analyst Summary & Investment Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Educational diagnostics that summarize strengths, risks and analytical classifications without investment advice.

ratios.title: Ratios & Quality Metrics
ratios.currentRatioFormula: Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities.
ratios.quickRatioFormula: Quick ratio = cash + receivables + marketable securities, divided by current liabilities.

valuation.marginDescription: Compares dividend-model value with the current demo market price. It is a model signal, not a recommendation.
valuation.extremeMarginWarning: Extreme model gap: dividend-based valuation can be very sensitive for low-yield or buyback-heavy companies.
valuation.modelLimitation: Dividend models assume stable payout behavior and constant long-run growth. Read this with multiples and peer context.

ggm.title: Gordon Growth Model Calculator
ggm.invalid: Required return must be greater than growth rate.
ggm.limitation: GGM is most useful for stable dividend payers and is highly sensitive when required return and growth are close.

summaryPanel.title: Analyst-Style Summary
summaryPanel.note: Educational analysis only. Not investment advice.
